comingLast.roast: holding them on 18 - at least the 37 km/h wind shares the guilt
averaging 0.6 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
1 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
safe by 2 unless the course gets generous late
only 2 clear of the blue balls - one blow-up and they are his
4 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
in on a 5-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
sitting 5 above the drop zone - Mort would love the company
5 from the double blue - a wipe here would be extremely on-brand
in the clubhouse, 6 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
